fields.description: A library banner, with the same text as the corrected toast, while the source folder cannot be reached or a folder sync fails. Each Retry press makes one root check (capped at 30 s) and at most one sync; no background retry. The banner clears as soon as the root lists with content (sync, Retry, Rescan or a watcher add) and the watcher restarts without a toast. partial-read stays log-only. Smoke 2026-10-26: single failed/successful retries work; F16 / FOLDER-RETRY-FEEDBACK-1 adds missing visible checking/failure feedback. R13 / LIBRARY-UI-TEXT-SIZE-1 increases readability. Functional PASS is not UX acceptance.
